audit.why: Mobile mage-bruiser with a stun dash. He pokes with Barrel Roll (Q) and disengages with Explosive Cask (R); Aatrox wins whenever Body Slam is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Explosive Cask (R) is 100/85/70 and knocks you back, so it can throw you out of your own Q pattern mid-combo. World Ender is 120/100/80 — hold it for after his displacement, not before.
audit.corrected: Explosive Cask (R) knocks you back on 100s and can throw you out of your own Q pattern. Bait Body Slam (E, 14s), then World Ender's amp wins the extended brawl.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Body Slam (E, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12) is a dash that stuns; Infernal Chains grounds it, so landing W before he charges removes both his engage and his escape. Happy Hour (P) heals him on every cast, so Grievous Wounds matters in long fights.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Gragas. Infernal Chains (W) grounds and drags him back to the centre if he doesn't leave the zone — hold it for Body Slam (E, 14s at rank 1) and he loses both his engage and his exit. Happy Hour (P) heals him on every cast, so buy Grievous Wounds. Explosive Cask can displace you mid-Q: cast R after it, never into it.

edits.after: Explosive Cask (R) knocks you back on 100s and can throw you out of your own Q pattern. Bait Body Slam (E, 14s), then World Ender's amp wins the extended brawl.

W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. He's mobile, so hold W until after he commits his dash, then chain him so he can't reset or kite your Q. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive Explosive Cask — never burn it for a single Q.
